doc.projectIntro: This quote covers a 100Mbps business fibre connection for J2 MSSP, backed by an SLA. The link is on-net with a low contention ratio and ample spare capacity, so the full 100Mbps is available at all times. Backhaul redundancy is built in via redundant paths and CGNAT — no separate failover link is required. The service is available from 1 August 2026 and is offered on a month-to-month basis; we do not offer fixed 12- or 24-month terms. All prices exclude VAT (15%).

items.detail: Connection and installation of the business fibre link.
On-net business fibre with SLA. Low contention (~1:5) with ample headroom to guarantee the full 100Mbps. Redundant backhaul paths via CGNAT.

doc.summaryNote: Month-to-month contract — no fixed term, no early termination penalty. Service available from 1 August 2026, subject to installation scheduling.
